framing: He Was Socrates has 'zero ops' on paper because every byte stays on-device — so the only operator who can see the daemon's health is the user. Surface that local telemetry as a status board the user opens themselves: TTFT, KV cache hit rate, audio engine, viseme frame budget, weight integrity, entitlements audit, asset install state, wondering log size on disk.
target_persona: The Mac owner running the local Socratic daemon — secondarily, Kaggle/DeepMind judges inspecting whether the NO-CLOUD invariant is verifiable rather than asserted. Both want the same artifact: a single dashboard that proves the device is the perimeter.
primary_surface: Operator status board: uptime/latency card grid, alert ledger, audit log table, integrity badge row. Cards refresh from local telemetry only — no network egress, mirroring the product invariant.
opus_4_7_capability: Function-calling-as-dispatch reframed as instrumentation. Each of the 4 functions (mode_classify · surface_past_wonder · ask_back · defer_to_human) is a metered call site with p50/p95 latency, success rate, and dispatch counts visible on the board — the same Gemma 4 native function-call surface, but read by the operator instead of the model.
mvp_scope: One screen: 9 status cards + alert ledger + audit log tail. Cards wired to live engine telemetry; alert ledger tails Phase transitions and >50ms viseme drift; audit log shows the last 24h of function-call dispatches. 4-day demo: refresh tick + one scripted alert (defer_to_human fired on a medical question).
one_liner_pitch: The status board for a daemon whose entire ops surface is your laptop — TTFT, KV hit rate, entitlements audit, weight SHA all in one local-only screen.
spec_alignment_notes: spec primary_surface lists Kaggle preview HTML (artifact A); the Ops Veteran reframing keeps single-file self-contained HTML and English-primary + Korean-for-identity policy intact, but treats the preview itself as the operator dashboard rather than a marketing scroll. Korean confined to engine status messages and bust subtitle per spec language_policy. Differentiators #4 (NO-CLOUD), #5 (PR-Λ TTFT 192ms), #6 (4-function dispatch) become the cards' source data — every metric cites a commit/bench/source-file per success_criteria.verifiability. No marketing superlatives; numbers match bench/2026-05-06-latency-bench.json exactly.
